data.title: Elara
data.about:
Step into a world of unmatched luxury at Elara by Meraas, the junction where tradition meets modern sophistication. Set against the stunning backdrop of Madinat Jumeirah, Burj Al Arab, and the pristine Jumeirah beach, Elara isn’t just a residence—it’s the key to a vibrant and opulent lifestyle.

Choose a home tailored to your taste, from 1 to 3-bedroom apartments to grand 4-bedroom penthouses, all harmoniously blending modernity and tradition to create bright, versatile living spaces.

Located minutes away from Dubai’s top destinations, Elara positions you perfectly to immerse yourself in lush landscapes, with amenities that foster a sense of community and connectivity. Don’t just move, elevate your life at Elara by Meraas, where every day is a step into luxury and comfort. Choose Elara, where dreams find a home.

characteristics_module.title: A new world of leisure at Madinat Jumeirah
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• 1-3 bedroom apartments and 4-bedroom penthouses
  • Sleek, bright, and modern interiors
  • Fusion of traditional and contemporary architecture
  • Premium amenities including a pool and modern gym
  • Children's play area and open recreational spaces
  • Enriching green spaces with walkways and private entrances
  • Social areas immersed in nature
  • Breathtaking views of top Dubai landmarks
  • Minutes away from premier shopping and entertainment spots
  • Easy access to public transport and educational institutions
  • A part of the renowned Dubai landmark portfolio by Meraas

location_tile.title: Located in Madinat Jumeirah
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Located in Madinat Jumeirah , and just minutes away from dynamic hubs like Dubai Media City and the Palm Jumeirah, its premier location near landmarks like the Burj Al Arab and Wild Wadi Waterpark™ ensures you're always close to the best Dubai has to offer. With top shopping destinations, public transport links, and reputable schools nearby, it stands as a nexus of luxury and convenience.

  • 05 Minutes to Mall Of Emirates
  • 05 Minutes to Souk Madinat Jumeirah
  • 10 Minutes to Bluewaters Island
  • 10 Minutes Jumeirah Beach Residence
  • 20 Minutes Dubai International Airport
